notes: Budget: 2 of 2 WebSearch calls used (cap reached, no further searches), 35 WebFetch calls used of 60. Results: 15 records, 12 publish, 2 hide, 1 not_a_group. Eleven of the publish records are status unknown with no summary, so the importer should hold them back; they are unknown because their websites did not resolve (DNS errors, twice each across www, bare and https forms; other domains resolved in the same session, so this does not look like rate limiting and no wait was needed), their site had no text (Ancient Coins), or no website was on file (Brandywine, Camp Tiagahton). Begirlworld is the only publish record with a summary, and it is dormant with only year-level dates, so I recommend it stays out of the live site until a current sign of life. Blackburn Group is a training firm (not_a_group). The Asian Pacific American Internal Revenue Employees and the City of Philadelphia association are hidden as private on their names alone, since neither public page could be read; confidence is noted on each. Search budget is the main gap: the next wave with fresh search budget should go to the eleven unknown groups, starting with Black Dance Resource Center, Best Foot Forward Philly, Billy Weeks Fellowship Program and Brandywine Valley Freedom Church. The Freedom Church result (freedomchurchphilly.org) is a different name and was not recorded; a later wave may check it separately.
